The '''Maw Nebulae''' was a huge [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA" /> that encompassed most of the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Maw Cluster/Legends|Maw Cluster]] was located at the heart of the Maw Nebulae, near the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]]. [[Star system/Legends|Star systems]] located whithin the nebula included [[Aeneid system/Legends|Aeneid]], [[Drualkiin system/Legends|Drualkiin]], [[Randa system/Legends|Randa]] and [[Zerm system/Legends|Zerm]].<ref name="TEA" />
